final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT trans.account_id, account.frequency, AVG(trans.amount) as avg_amount FROM trans JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id GROUP BY trans.account_id, account.frequency), step2 AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) as avg_of_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY frequency) SELECT step1.account_id, step1.frequency, step1.avg_amount, step1.avg_amount / step2.avg_of_avg as ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.frequency = step2.frequency ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
